title: Gossamer Knight

A level 46 Fae that attacks with shock (melee).

Weak stabslash   Resists shock

⭐ Seen as an elite 1 times (0.9% of sightings). Elites have 3× HP, hit 1.4× harder, give 3× XP and 2.5× loot.
